orig.zht: 評曰：[[任峻|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16a]]始興義兵，以歸太祖，闢土殖穀，倉庾盈溢，庸績致矣。
orig.zhs: 评曰：[[任峻|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16a]]始兴义兵，以归太祖，辟土殖谷，仓庾盈溢，庸绩致矣。

vern.zht: 陳壽評論道：[[任峻|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16a]]起初興起義兵，由此歸附太祖；開墾土地、種植穀物，糧倉充實滿溢，功績得以成就。
vern.zhs: 陈寿评论道：[[任峻|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16a]]起初兴起义兵，由此归附太祖；开垦土地、种植谷物，粮仓充实满溢，功绩得以成就。

passages.en: Chen Shou appraises: When [[Ren Jun|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16a]] first raised troops for the righteous cause, he submitted to Cao Cao. He opened up land for cultivation and planted grain, until the granaries were filled to overflowing. In this, he rendered great service.

orig.zht: [[蘇則|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16b]]威以平亂，旣政事之良，又矯矯剛直，風烈足稱。
orig.zhs: [[苏则|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16b]]威以平乱，既政事之良，又矫矫刚直，风烈足称。

vern.zht: [[蘇則|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16b]]以威勢平定了叛亂，既是政務良才，又剛強正直，風節和功業足可稱道。
vern.zhs: [[苏则|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16b]]以威势平定了叛乱，既是政务良才，又刚强正直，风节和功业足可称道。

passages.en: [[Su Ze|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16b]] quelled disorder through the weight of his authority. He was not only an able administrator, but also upright and unyielding, and his high principles were worthy of praise.

vern.zht: [[杜畿|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16c]]寬嚴相濟，用恩惠使百姓安康。
vern.zhs: [[杜畿|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16c]]宽严相济，用恩惠使百姓安康。

passages.en: [[Du Ji|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16c]] combined leniency with firmness and brought peace to the people through benevolent governance.

orig.zht: [[鄭渾|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16e]]、[[倉慈|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16f]]，恤理有方。抑皆魏代之名守乎！
orig.zhs: [[郑浑|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16e]]、[[仓慈|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16f]]，恤理有方。抑皆魏代之名守乎！

vern.zht: [[鄭渾|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16e]]、[[倉慈|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16f]]，撫卹治理有方。他們大概都是魏朝有名的郡守吧！
vern.zhs: [[郑浑|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16e]]、[[仓慈|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16f]]，抚恤治理有方。他们大概都是魏朝有名的郡守吧！

passages.en: [[Zheng Hun|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16e]] and [[Cang Ci|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16f]] likewise showed skill in caring for and governing the people. Perhaps all of them may be considered renowned Grand Administrators of Wei!

orig.zht: [[恕|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16d]]屢陳時政，經論治體，蓋有可觀焉。
orig.zhs: [[恕|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16d]]屡陈时政，经论治体，盖有可观焉。

vern.zht: 杜[[恕|/zh-hant/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16d]]屢次陳說時政，經常論述治國綱領，確有值得一看的地方。
vern.zhs: 杜[[恕|/zh-hans/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16d]]屡次陈说时政，经常论述治国纲领，确有值得一看的地方。

passages.en: [[Du Shu|/translations/sanguozhi/wei-shu-16d]] repeatedly set forth the strengths and weaknesses of current policy and discussed the principles of governance; his writings, too, are well worth reading.
